PLAN "Pregnancy-safe Strength (12 weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and function during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower & core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 6m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper volume":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
